title: Add real-runtime smoke evals, provider failure paths, and launch-gate evidence

gates.name: real-runtime evals
gates.command: pytest backend/tests/model_adapters backend/tests/agent_harness backend/tests/integration backend/tests/security -k 'real_runtime or provider_failure or eval'

verify: First-demo evidence includes one real text model run over scoped Plant context and one real vision run over an accepted uploaded photo.
Missing config, timeout, malformed output, rate limit, forbidden action suggestion, provider secret-like output, and budget exhausted paths are covered.
Anti-cheat gates prove fake/mock/stub/hardcoded runtime outputs cannot satisfy MVP runtime/demo acceptance.
evidence_required: first-demo trace/eval evidence for text and vision profiles
VERDICT: PASS, SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass, HUMAN_CHECKPOINT: done, ROLLBACK_RECOVERY_NOTE: present
constraints: Test-only mocks may be used in automated tests but cannot redefine product acceptance.
Trace events record operational evidence without exposing hidden reasoning.
Token/cost/latency and cached-token fields are recorded when available.
invariants: No raw provider output publication bypass.
